Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the two main changes: neutral wording for wait.http error messages and stripping nested local addresses from errors. It matches the changeset and the linked issue's first two cases. The 'fix(wait):' prefix is a conventional-commit style and is acceptable. The title is slightly long at 75 characters but remains clear.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changes in internal/runtime/builtin/wait/wait.go map to `#4015` cases 1 and 2: the neutral fallback wording and the recursive withoutSource helper. The changes in wait_test.go update the expected wording and add TestRequestErrorClearsNestedLocalAddress and TestHTTPClientSideErrorNotBlamedOnServer, which test those same cases. No unrelated code change was found in the reviewed wait.go. The wait_test.go diff was not read directly; its scope is taken from the supplied summary.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the repository template closely. It has a Summary that states the problem and why it matters, a Changes list with before and after CLI output, and a Core change section with the mechanism and a code snippet with file and line. It has a Testing section that names the two new tests, states they fail on main and pass with the fix, and gives a manual check against a real resetting proxy. It has a Performance section with a no-risk reason and an Out of scope section that explains the excluded third case and links it to `#4015`. The Checklist is absent, and the Related Issues section does not use the Closes keyword because the issue stays open. Those omissions are non-critical. The description is complete for this change.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Directly linked issue `#4015` lists three cases. Cases 1 and 2 are implemented at head bedbd42. Case 1 [`#4015`]: the fallback in requestError now reads "details left out, they may contain the URL or response text". Errors from client.Do that are not *net.OpError, such as the invalid header value, reach this fallback. Case 2 [`#4015`]: withoutSource clears Source on the outer *net.OpError and recurses into nested *net.OpError values in op.Err, so the proxyconnect inner error no longer carries the ephemeral local address. Case 3 [`#4015`] is unmet. The status line in waitHTTP still formats "wait: http %s got status %d, want %d" with no proxy name, and the PR explicitly leaves this case out. The issue allows either narrowing the spec sentence in specs/039-wait.md or adding the proxy to the status line. The PR description also says "Fixes `#4015`" while case 3 remains open. The spec file was not inspected, so its current text is unverified. **Resolution** Resolve issue `#4015` case 3. Either narrow the sentence in specs/039-wait.md so it applies only to the request-failed line, or add the proxy host and port to the status-line output in waitHTTP and cover it with a test. Then update the PR description so it does not claim full resolution unless case 3 is addressed.
